recap.headline: 曼联 0–1 雷克瑟姆
recap.summary: 曼联主场以 0–1 不敌雷克瑟姆。本场进球：Sam Smith（39'）。比赛在Helsinki Olympic Stadium进行。

goals.name: Sam Smith
goals.text: Goal! Manchester United 0, Wrexham 1. Sam Smith (Wrexham) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lewis O'Brien.

recap.headline: 曼联 5–0 罗森博格
recap.summary: 曼联客场以 5–0 战胜罗森博格。本场进球：Shea Lacey（31'）、约书亚·齐尔克泽（56'）、Jacob Devaney（63'）、哈里·阿马斯（72'）、Ethan Williams（84'）。比赛在Lerkendal Stadion进行。

goals.name: Shea Lacey
goals.text: Goal! Rosenborg 0, Manchester United 1. Shea Lacey (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.

goals.name: Joshua Zirkzee
goals.text: Goal! Rosenborg 0, Manchester United 2. Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.

goals.name: Jacob Devaney
goals.text: Goal! Rosenborg 0, Manchester United 3. Jacob Devaney (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.

goals.name: Harry Amass
